finding.text: A stale comment says the opposite of what the code now does: `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:518` `slug_of` still says "a string added in the browser gets the same id", but `Task.List.make` now gives a string add an `Item.short_id()`. Reword it to say the slug is only a folder name (as `Task.js` already does).

The same-title rule is written twice: `same_title` in `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:516` is a copy of `Improvements.same` in `core/Task/Improvements.js:23` (law 6). Put it in one place, for example `Task.same_title`, and have both call it.

Not every special case moved into a class verb. Only the verdict strings (`Task.replay_line`) and the improvements reinforce (`Improvements`) moved. Adding a task with its folder, `move`, `folder` and `pages` are still in `run_item_now`. Each is listed with where it goes in `Servex/doc/item-tool.md`, "Special cases still in the tool", which is what ask 3 allows when time runs out.

The reviewed patch stops at 8961c6eea, but the branch has moved on (`worktree/item-generic`, now at b2649a4aa). The later commits add `LIVE_CAP`, let a browser page line be written, and revert the 162 `files.jsonl` noise rows that 8961c6eea had swept in. I ran the tests on b2649a4aa.

The tests still write rows into tracked repo files on every run. After my run, the worktree had new `zz-item-tool-test-46096` rows in `public/framework/files.jsonl` and a line in `public/framework/ai/sessions/task-moves.jsonl`. This happened before this branch too, but it is what fed the noise into 8961c6eea.

`Servex/agents/PromptLines.test.mjs` fails 2 of 8 checks (`add_question`, `roots()`). It fails the same way on `worktree/one-writer`, so this branch did not cause it. Still, ask 5 says "`Servex/agents/*.test.mjs` passes", and the landing should say this one fails.

When a key matches both a data field and a child id, the data field wins: `hop()` (`Servex/agents/page_tools.js:937-939`) tries `node.get(key)` before `member(key)`, so a field holding an object hides a child with the same id. Random ids make this unlikely.
